submitted.rationale: I measured 5 compositions spread across the line (Sb fraction 0.20, 0.41, 0.52, 0.67, 0.83). Every EQE was within about ±0.0025%, which is indistinguishable from zero. So under 2.1 eV illumination at pH 6.4 the Co–Sb–O line gives essentially no photoresponse. Index 12 (Sb 0.415) had the only positive reading (0.00068%) and is submitted as the nominal best, but the difference from the others is within noise.

rejected.reason: Near the CoSb2O6 trirutile composition; EQE -0.0019%, no photoresponse
